rationale: The native DesignIR materializer treats clip-path none (any case, surrounding whitespace) as no clip instead of storing the keyword as SVG path data, matching what the JS lane already did, and a metamorphic suite checks that eleven inert style declarations leave the drawlist, the following sibling and the Skia raster unchanged. The licensing page gains two idea-only attribution rows. A local paint correction plus tests and docs; no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
